headerDisplay: Expose camera snapshots as HomeKit motion sensors using on-device object detection. Add one **Snapshot** per source/camera, then add **Sensors** to it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log.

name.title: Snapshot Name
name.description: Used as a prefix for auto-named sensors.

url.title: Snapshot URL
url.description: URL used to retrieve a still snapshot from the camera.

storeSnapshots.title: Store snapshots
storeSnapshots.description: Never stores images. Normal stores the original snapshot. Annotated stores the image returned by YOLO with detections.

snapshotDirectory.title: Snapshot Directory
snapshotDirectory.description: Required when Store snapshots is Normal or Annotated.

snapshotPrefix.title: Snapshot prefix
snapshotPrefix.description: Prefix used for saved snapshot filenames.
